behaviour.help: What a computer unit does until the story changes it (docs/AI.md).

node.help: advance: walk at the enemy; hold: stand still, hit what comes near; guard: sleep until an enemy is in reach; loot: take what it goes for, then leave; escape: walk to an exit of the map and leave.

mode.help: advance, hold, guard (sleeps until woken), guardArea (wakes by an area or distance), seek (heads for a target), patrol (walks a route), loot (plays its goesFor marks and never walks at the enemy; with nothing left to take it escapes; on a map unit or addUnit it needs goesFor with chests, villages, doors or steal), escape (walks to the nearest exit of the map and leaves it; the map needs exits).

wake.help: once: wakes for good; react: only hits what it can reach this turn.

group.help: Group name (letters, digits, _ and -): a wakeGroup command or a woken member wakes the whole group.

fromTurn.help: The behaviour starts in this round; before it the unit holds.

area.help: Wakes when an enemy enters this rectangle.

within.help: Wakes when an enemy is this many squares away (an area or this is needed).

measure.help: How within is measured: squares (default) or what the walk costs; needs within.

place.help: Seek: head for this structure of the map (it needs an id).

x.help: Seek: head for this square (column; needs y).

y.help: Seek: head for this square (row; needs x).

unit.help: A unit id of the map.

order.help: Acts earlier with a lower number (scripted-style computer players).

weights.help: A named weight set of game.json rules.ai.weights.

caution.help: none: it ignores danger when it walks at the enemy.

below.help: Hit point percent that sends it back.

until.help: Hit point percent at which it returns (more than below).

terrain.help: Terrain it heads for (at least one).

useItems.help: May use healing items while retreating.

idleTurns.help: Rounds of standing still before it moves.

route.help: Patrol: the squares it walks, 2 to 32; the last leads back to the first.

heals.help: retreating: its healing staves are used only on allies that are retreating.

staffFirst.help: Chance (percent) that, before its usual choice, it uses a staff it could use now; the game rolls 0 to 99 and it acts when the roll is at most this (0 = one time in a hundred). Missing = never.

staffPick.help: lastPlaced: its staves go to the unit placed last among the legal targets (an afflicting staff skips foes that already have any condition or cannot be hit).

inflictOnlyOn.help: casters: a staff whose condition stops staves (a silence) goes only to foes that carry something it would stop (a staff they can use now, or a weapon of a forbidden kind).

lootBlockedBy.help: units: enemy units standing in the way block the looter's paths to the remaining loot. While every path is blocked it escapes; it goes back to looting on the turn a path opens. nothing: only walls and closed doors block (units in the way never count).

attacks.help: false: it never starts a fight (it still counterattacks), in any mode.

unit.help: A unit as an addUnit command adds it; a map's units list takes one more key (facing).

id.help: Id events name the unit by (letters, digits, _ and -). A unit with a character is known by the character's id: leave this out.

character.help: A character of data/characters.json; type, name and level default to the character's.

type.help: Unit type (not needed with a character, or with a class job that has a unit type).

side.help: Id of one of the map's sides.

name.help: Display name (a character's own by default).

level.help: Level of the unit (at most the game's maximum).

items.help: Items it carries (replaces its type's or character's).

skills.help: Skills added to those of its type and character.

stats.help: Exact stats instead of the type's (a stat written here is never shifted by difficulty).

xp.help: Experience it starts with (needs a rank table: rules.progression.levels).

ranks.help: Weapon rank per weapon group it starts with (needs data/ranks.json).

job.help: The unit's job (needs data/jobs.json); jobs, learned and equipped belong to it.

learned.help: What was learned in it (costs nothing here).
What the unit has learned in its current job (needs job).

equipped.help: Learned skills and abilities it has equipped (needs job).

goesFor.help: What a computer unit walks to (computer sides only).

behaviour.help: What a computer unit does (computer sides only; docs/AI.md).

difficulty.help: Only on these difficulties (computer sides only; leave out for all).

difficultyShift.help: The difficulty setting changes this unit.

uses.help: Uses left (at most the item's own; not for unlimited items).

defeated.help: Win when every matching unit is defeated.

reach.help: Win when a unit ends a move inside this area.

by.help: Only units that match (default: any of the person's units).

round.help: Win when this round is reached.

survive.help: Win by surviving this many rounds.

defeated.help: Lose when every matching unit is defeated.

reach.help: Lose when a unit ends a move inside this area.

round.help: Lose when this round is reached.

objectives.help: What the player is told to do, and the rules that decide it (docs/EVENTS.md Objectives). Also what an objective command writes.

text.help: The line shown for the objective.

win.help: Ways to win: any one is enough.

lose.help: Ways to lose: any one is enough.

filter.help: Which units: one by id, or all of a side / team / type / tag, or {} for every unit.

tag.help: Every unit whose type has this tag.

actor.help: The unit that set the event off (true). Only in the commands of an event whose trigger has one: reach, defeated, fight, talk, promoted, place.

prep.help: The preparation screen before the battle (docs/EVENTS.md Preparation).

side.help: The human side the deployed characters join (default: the first human side).

slots.help: The squares characters can be deployed on (1 to 64).

limit.help: How many may be deployed (at most the number of slots; default all).

slot.help: Which slot it must stand on (numbered from 1).

forbidden.help: Characters that cannot be deployed here.

fixed.help: Units of the map that are always in (placed where the map puts them).

shop.help: One preparation shop (or use shops for several).

sells.help: Items it sells (each needs a price).

changes.help: Named map changes that applyChange / revertChange commands use (docs/EVENTS.md Changing the map).

tile.help: Tile number of the map's tile layer (-1 = no tile; needs tileLayer).

id.help: The id of a structure the map placed.

kind.help: The structure kind it turns into (same size).

structures.help: Structures that turn into another kind.

keepTile.help: Squares whose terrain changes keep their tile.
